==Description==
'''Candy Cane Lane''' was a colorful [[Maps|map]] that had a completely straight path with no corners.

==Design & Path==
'''Candy Cane Lane''' was a candy wonderland which was quite evident as the ground was light red and the hills were pink. A massive light red baseplate surrounded the map. Hills surrounded the path, but the terrain was rather flat. The trees around the map mostly had white bark and pink leaves. There was also a chocolate river running through the middle of the map, with a simple wooden bridge spanning it. The river blocked any towers being placed on that part of the map. Lollipops and chocolate bars were found around the map.

The brown path began and ended at two candy caves. The path was dead straight, with no turns and was very short.

==Strategy==
*The [[Military Base]] is not recommended as the path is very short, meaning that the lifetime of units will also be short.
*The [[Pyromancer]] and [[Freezer]] can help slow down the enemies on this very short map.

==Trivia==
*This was considered to be one of the shortest maps in the game.
*At the end of the chocolate river, a sign reading "''F for carrot''" and a carrot could be seen.
*This map was later remade into [[Candy Valley (Versus)]].
